testo:
■ Ignore any effects that would prevent you from casting this spell.
■ Destroy one of your opponent's creatures that has power 3000 or less.
■ Kicker Costicon (When you cast this spell, you may pay an additional Costicon. If you do, this spell gets the following OD ability.)
